description: Find a Cardano token, liquidity pool, NFT collection, stake pool, ADA Handle, address, transaction, block or epoch by name, ticker or identifier. Use this first whenever you have a name or ticker rather than an exact id: each result names the tool to call next and the id to pass. Stake amounts in results are whole ADA.

limit.description: How many results to return (1-20, default 8).

query.description: Name, ticker, `$handle`, address, pool id, policy id, transaction hash, block height or epoch number.

name: search
title: Search Cardano entities
